name: SODIUM CROMOGLYCATE OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION 5 ML 1 PIECE
description: Sodium Cromoglycate Ophthalmic Solution 5 ml is a medication used to prevent and treat allergic conjunctivitis, vernal keratoconjunctivitis, and vernal keratitis. It works by stabilizing mast cells, which prevents the release of chemicals responsible for allergic symptoms in the eyes. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
